json.name: LIV-02 sim drill: lanes halt and freeze (uat-sim only)
json.description: Import ONLY into the uat-sim workcell. Addresses only SIM-STACK and SIM-FAST: a STACK step, a F.A.S.T. step on lane fast, an overlapping STACK step and a final STACK step behind a barrier. Refuses the real tool names STACK2-6 and FA100056 before any step is queued. Failures are injected by stopping a sim server mid-step, never by an invalid argument.

parameters.name: stack_tool
parameters.label: STACK tool instance
parameters.description: Name of the simulated STACK tool instance in the uat-sim workcell (exact case).

parameters.name: fast_tool
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. tool instance
parameters.description: Name of the simulated F.A.S.T. tool instance in the uat-sim workcell (exact case).

parameters.name: batch_label
parameters.label: Batch label
parameters.description: Run label at the start of every STACK step key; only its first 20 characters are used.

parameters.name: robot
parameters.label: STACK robot
parameters.description: Placeholder robot name; the simulated STACK server does not use it.

parameters.name: labware_profile
parameters.label: Labware profile
parameters.description: Placeholder labware profile; the simulated STACK server does not use it.

parameters.name: fast_step_source_start_row
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. source start row
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer source_start_row (one or two letters).

parameters.name: fast_step_dest_start_row
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. destination start row
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer dest_start_row (one or two letters).

parameters.name: fast_step_volume
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. volume (uL)
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer volume in microlitres; must be above 0.

parameters.name: fast_step_expected_tray_id
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. expected tray id
parameters.description: Optional F.A.S.T. transfer expected_tray_id; blank sends none.
